Current genuine JackalVoiceRx declares slot0 on_insert and slot1 on_remove, but current source calls on_insert. Admit only correction to the real removal hook, preservation of the original identity and all historical claims, and fresh native call-slot/runtime checks; no behavior hardening or matching waiver.
